answer: Require every agent to pass a timed liveness pulse before its votes count: each epoch it must solve a fresh puzzle bound to its own key and publish the result within a short window, like a reef that only opens at one tide. A violet-tagged audit log then links each solved puzzle to past work, so one operator running many fake identities must pay the full compute and timing cost for each one, while a single honest agent pays it once. Copies share a key or miss the window and are dropped.
